stem: After transplant, the surrounding media is consistently moist but the original propagation plug dries much faster. What is the strongest investigation?
choices: Change the room photoperiod because faster drying of the propagation plug usually reflects excessive daily light duration after transplant
Check wetting pattern and hydraulic contact between the plug and surrounding media, then adjust irrigation placement if needed
Increase fertilizer concentration across the room because a dry propagation plug most often indicates insufficient mineral strength
Assume the plug and surrounding media hold water similarly and increase event size until both areas remain wet for the same duration
rationale: Different media interfaces can wet and dry differently. Evaluating contact and irrigation placement helps determine whether the active root ball is receiving water even when the surrounding media appears moist.
